success.description: You produce up to 8 ounces of gold (enough coins) to make 10 gold.
You produce up to 1 pound of gold (enough to make about 20 gold).

chaosStar.description: The gold is flawed and tarnished; impure. You can hope no one notices the difference, or you can use traditional smelting to remove the impurities and recoup about 75% of the gold transmuted.

conservative.requirements: 12 power, engaged with target base metal. This spell takes about an hour to cast. You may recharge this spell as a manoeuvre whenever you like. It doesn't on its own. Effect: You really and truly transmute base metals into gold. While this spell is recharging, your target becomes gold. When the spell recharges, it reverts to its original material.
conservative.name: The Final Transmutation

success.description: You cast the spell and the target becomes a statue.
As above, and add 2 recharge tokens to this spell.

chaosStar.description: You are affected in exactly the same way as the target.

sigmarsComet.description: If the target dies while affected by this spell, he’ll remain flesh and blood, but never turn to gold forever.

reckless.requirements: 10 power, target within medium range. You throw a gold coin at the target when you cast this spell; the gold coin is consumed. Effect: The target is transmuted to a statue of gold. While this spell is recharging, he gains the Petrified condition. When the spell recharges, he returns to normal (minus any damage he’s suffered in the meantime).
reckless.name: The Final Transmutation
